output.title: Decreasing students' stress through time management training

scenes.narration: University students worldwide face increasing mental health concerns. In one cited study, seventy-five percent of community college students reported at least moderate stress levels.
scenes.layout_description: A central character sits slumped at a desk, surrounded by scattered papers, with the text element floating above.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink line art on a cream background. A university student sits at a desk, head resting in one hand, looking overwhelmed. Papers are scattered around. A subtle orange highlight circles the student's head, emphasizing distress.

scenes.narration: Current research shows that time-related demands are a serious problem for many students. These include high workload, time pressure, and the challenge of self-organized learning.
scenes.layout_description: A large clock face dominates the center, with heavy weights hanging from its hands.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink sketch on a cream background. A large, slightly imperfect clock face has heavy, dark weights tied to its hands with ropes. Yellow accents highlight the numbers on the clock face, symbolizing intense time pressure.

scenes.narration: To successfully deal with these time-related demands, time management interventions are frequently recommended as a part of student support programs to decrease feelings of stress.
scenes.layout_description: A life preserver is being tossed toward the viewer, with the text element written across its bands.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink line art on a cream background. A classic ring-shaped life preserver is flying through the air. The bands of the preserver are colored with bright orange accents, representing a rescue tool for struggling students.

scenes.narration: Despite these recommendations, research concerning the effectiveness of time management training programs is scarce. Clear conclusions about their effect on student stress cannot be drawn.
scenes.layout_description: A magnifying glass hovers over an entirely blank open book.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink art on a cream background. An open book lies flat with completely empty pages. A magnifying glass with a yellow tinted lens examines the blank pages, highlighting the lack of existing empirical evidence.

scenes.narration: The authors wanted to examine the effects of a time management training program on perceived control of time and perceived stress in higher education.
scenes.layout_description: A student stands confidently, holding a steering wheel that looks like a clock.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink line art on a cream background. A student stands upright, hands gripping a steering wheel where the center is a clock face. Orange accents highlight the student's firm grip, symbolizing taking control.

scenes.narration: They used a non-equivalent dependent variable design. This means they trained one single group and measured variables they expected to change, plus one control variable.
scenes.layout_description: A classic balancing scale holds two dynamic arrows on one side and a static block on the other.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink sketch on a cream background. A balancing scale. On the left pan, two arrows point in opposite directions (up and down), highlighted in yellow. On the right pan, a solid, unmoving square block is accented in orange.

scenes.narration: Perceived stress and perceived control of time were the dependent variables. Demands served as the control variable, which should not be changed by the training.
scenes.layout_description: Three distinct boxes are aligned horizontally, each containing a specific symbol and text element.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink art on a cream background. Three boxes. The first box has a downward arrow (stress). The second box has an upward arrow (control). Both arrows have yellow highlights. The third box has a flat, horizontal line (demands) with an orange highlight.

scenes.narration: According to cited researchers Frese and colleagues, this design effectively rules out nonspecific placebo effects if the training only changes the experimental variables, not demands.
scenes.layout_description: A clipboard displays a checklist with a large X drawn over a pill icon.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink line art on a cream background. A clipboard holds a piece of paper. On the paper, a drawing of a medical capsule (pill) is crossed out with a bold, orange 'X', symbolizing the rejection of a placebo effect.

scenes.narration: The study started with forty-eight undergraduate students. Twenty-three filled in all questionnaires directly before, two weeks after, and four weeks after the training intervention.
scenes.layout_description: A large cluster of stick figures transitions into a smaller, distinct group of figures on a timeline.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink line art on a cream background. On the left, a dense crowd of simple stick figures. An arrow points to the right, leading to a much smaller, neatly arranged group of stick figures standing on a horizontal line. Yellow accents highlight the smaller group.

scenes.narration: These twenty-three students had a mean age of twenty-three point three zero years. About half of the participants, fifty-two percent, were female.
scenes.layout_description: Two student figures stand side-by-side, with the text elements written neatly above them.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink art on a cream background. Two simple student figures, one with short hair and one with long hair, stand together. A subtle orange circle encompasses both figures, representing the demographic makeup of the final sample.

scenes.narration: Before the training, most students reported having no or little experience concerning the use of time management strategies. None reported having quite a lot of experience.
scenes.layout_description: A simple bar chart shows tall bars on the left and completely empty space on the right.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink line art on a cream background. A bar chart with an x-axis and y-axis. The first two bars are tall and colored with yellow scribble shading. The remaining spaces on the x-axis are completely flat and empty.

scenes.narration: The evaluated training lasted for four hours. It was developed as a rather homogeneous intervention focusing on prioritizing, goal setting, strategy development, and daily planning.
scenes.layout_description: A large hourglass sits next to an open notebook with a checklist.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink sketch on a cream background. A traditional hourglass with sand flowing down, accented in orange. Next to it is an open notebook showing a bulleted list with checkmarks, representing the structured training session.

scenes.narration: Firstly, students reflected upon their current academic and extracurricular activities. They noted these down, reflected on their importance, and tried to define the most important ones.
scenes.layout_description: A figure looks into a hand mirror, which reflects a list of tasks instead of a face.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink line art on a cream background. A person holds up a hand mirror. Inside the mirror's reflection, instead of a face, there is a list of various tasks and icons (a book, a ball). Yellow accents highlight the mirror's frame.

scenes.narration: Next, they defined concrete, challenging, and proximal goals for their important activities. They asked themselves what they wanted to achieve in detail and defined deadlines.
scenes.layout_description: An archery target with an arrow in the bullseye sits next to a calendar page.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink art on a cream background. A round target with an arrow hitting the exact center, accented in orange. Beside it is a single calendar page with one specific date circled boldly in yellow.

scenes.narration: Then, they developed a strategy for achieving their goals, noted down different steps, and focused on daily planning to decide what to do and when.
scenes.layout_description: A staircase leads upward, with a small clock icon resting on each individual step.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink line art on a cream background. A set of stairs ascending from left to right. On each step sits a small, simple clock face. A yellow dashed line traces the path up the stairs, showing a step-by-step strategy.

scenes.narration: The last part of the training dealt with monitoring of task completion. Trainees were instructed to monitor their tasks each day to track their progress.
scenes.layout_description: A hand holds a pen, actively ticking off a box on a daily checklist.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink sketch on a cream background. A close-up of a hand holding a pen. The pen is drawing a thick checkmark inside a square box on a piece of paper. The checkmark is highlighted in bright orange.

scenes.narration: To measure perceived stress, the researchers used the tension scale. This scale contains aspects of mental fatigue, trouble relaxing, and feelings of nervousness.
scenes.layout_description: A thermometer-like gauge contains a jagged, erratic line instead of liquid.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink line art on a cream background. A gauge resembling a thermometer. Inside the glass tube, instead of a straight line of liquid, there is a sharp, jagged, erratic line colored in orange, representing nervous tension.

scenes.narration: Perceived control of time was measured with a ten-item scale. It covers feeling in control, correctly estimating time for tasks, and avoiding procrastination.
scenes.layout_description: A hand firmly grasps a pocket watch, with a straight, clear path stretching out ahead.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink art on a cream background. A hand securely holds a classic pocket watch. Extending from the watch into the distance is a perfectly straight, clear pathway, accented with yellow borders, symbolizing control and foresight.

scenes.narration: The scale demands was used as the control variable. It covers external duties and the amount of work one has to do.
scenes.layout_description: A massive, towering stack of books and folders rests heavily on a small desk.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink sketch on a cream background. A small, simple desk is completely overwhelmed by a towering, precarious stack of thick books, folders, and papers. Orange accents highlight the sheer volume of the stack.

scenes.narration: Did they use the strategies? Trainees reported a nearly significant increase in time management behavior two weeks after training, and a significant increase four weeks after.
scenes.layout_description: A line graph shows an upward trending line across three distinct points on the x-axis.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink line art on a cream background. A simple line graph. The line starts low, goes up slightly at the middle point, and rises sharply at the third point. The final point is circled in bright yellow.

scenes.narration: As expected, trainees reported significantly less stress two weeks after the training compared to the pretest. This significant decrease was also present four weeks after.
scenes.layout_description: A large arrow points downward next to the jagged tension gauge from earlier.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink art on a cream background. The tension gauge from scene 17 is shown again, but the jagged line inside is much lower. A large, bold arrow pointing straight down is drawn next to it, filled with orange.

scenes.narration: Perceived control of time increased, but with a time lag. There was a moderate tendency two weeks after, and a significant increase four weeks after training.
scenes.layout_description: A clock face is surrounded by a glowing aura that expands outward.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink sketch on a cream background. A simple clock face in the center. Around it are concentric, expanding circles drawn with dashed lines, colored in yellow, representing a growing sense of control over time.

scenes.narration: Furthermore, the researchers found no significant changes concerning demands between the measurement before training and the measurements two and four weeks after the training.
scenes.layout_description: A completely flat, horizontal line is drawn on a graph next to a stack of books.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink line art on a cream background. A graph shows a perfectly flat, horizontal line across three points. Next to the graph is the same stack of books from scene 19, unchanged in size. Subtle orange accents on the flat line.

scenes.narration: The training effect was much stronger for students with no or little experience compared to students with moderate and some experience, especially regarding perceived stress.
scenes.layout_description: Two figures are shown: one leaping high into the air, the other taking a small step.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink art on a cream background. Two stick figures. The one on the left is leaping high into the air with a dynamic yellow action line behind it. The one on the right is taking a small, normal step forward.

scenes.narration: The authors conclude that the training led to a decrease of perceived stress and an increase of perceived control of time, while demands remained unchanged.
scenes.layout_description: A balanced composition shows a downward arrow, an upward arrow, and a flat line side-by-side.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink sketch on a cream background. Three symbols side-by-side: a downward pointing arrow (orange), an upward pointing arrow (yellow), and a flat horizontal line (black). They represent stress down, control up, and demands flat.

scenes.narration: The authors suggest that prioritizing and goal setting might give more orientation in one's studies, which might reduce stress and foster perceived control of time.
scenes.layout_description: A compass points directly toward a bright, shining star.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-like black ink line art on a cream background. A navigational compass with its needle pointing up and to the right. At the end of the needle's path is a large, hand-drawn star, heavily accented in bright yellow.

scenes.narration: Therefore, time management training might be beneficial for undergraduate students' well-being. Nevertheless, more intervention studies with larger samples are necessary to contribute to robust conclusions.
scenes.layout_description: A smiling student holds a certificate, while a magnifying glass hovers over a large crowd in the background.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black ink art on a cream background. In the foreground, a simple, smiling student figure holds a rolled certificate. In the background, a large group of faint stick figures is being examined by a magnifying glass with an orange rim.
